items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 This is a pre-emptive review summarizing
items.summary: This is a pre-emptive review summarizing why I gave this game a try. While browsing the Genshin Impact subreddit about a combat bug in an endgame mode, the recent response to a difficult endgame mode in this game came up. They mentioned more frequent pulls, a positive response to feedback, and demonstrated a willingness to listen to players. No matter how the game is, I won't change my review. Listening to players is worth 5* in my eyes, and should be firmly encouraged!!

items.title: [Google Play 差评] ★1 i have already left a positive review be
items.summary: i have already left a positive review before, but now I'm revoking it. i mentioned that the devs are indeed passionate about this game, but it's crucial to also listen to your player base. please, fix the GLARING issue and listen to the fans. Do not remove the good features which are basically the only things players log in for. This game is dying again, and im heartbroken to see it on the brink of death for the SECOND time. please listen to the fanbase.
